passage:
The yak has lost its map. “Help!” yelps the yak! “Help!” 
The yak is in the sun. 
It is hot in the sun. Don’t fret yak.

The yak trots to get a fan. He pops the fan on. 
“Help!” yelps Yak. It is hot.

The yak trots to get a hat. He pops the hat on.

Yak sits by a plant. The plant is wet. 
“Yum!” said the yak. “Yum, yum, yum!”
